Debt: amount of debt owed by the bank client
Overdue days: number of days the client's payments are overdue
Initial limit: initial credit limit assigned to the client
BIRTHDATE: date of birth of the bank client
EDU: education level of the bank client
TERM: term of the credit in months
Credit history rating: credit history rating of the client
LV_AREA: area or region where the client lives
LV_SETTLEMENTNAME: name of the settlement or city where the client resides
INDUSTRYNAME: industry sector of the client's employment
UNDERAGECHILDRENCOUNT: number of underage children the client has
FAMILYSTATUS: family status or marital status of the client
target: credit scoring target variable (0 - low credit scoring, 1 - high credit scoring)
